system.prerequisites: Korath heritage, Sentence of Judgement, Level 5
system.description:
KETHRANI

The Verse of Judgement remembers those it has named.
Whenever you successfully Demoralise a creature, you may mark it with your Testament until the end of your next turn.
The first time that creature inflicts HP damage upon you or one of your allies before the mark ends, it suffers Essence damage equal to your level. A creature can trigger Consequence Written only once from each successful Demoralise.

Prerequisites Korath heritage, Sentence of Judgement, Level 5

Use after a successful Demoralise (target the creature): a one-round mark effect on it; when it first damages you or an ally, it suffers Essence damage equal to your level — the card says how much.
